about_the_game:
◆Rules

At the beginning of the game, each player is automatically dealt 5 cards for the attacker and 5 cards for the defender.

Cards for the attacker

　- Lion (attack power 2) x 2

　- Zebra (attack power 1) x 2

　- Cat (Attack Power 0) x 1

Defender's card

　- Anesthetic Gun (Defense 2) CT 2 turns

　- Rope (Defense 1) CT 1 turn

　- Bare hands (defense 0) no CT

The attacker's card cannot be used again once it has been used.

◆How to play

When the game starts, the attacker and defender each set a card in their hand.

The cards are opened at the same time, and the difference between the attacker's value and the defender's value is the damage to the player who plays the card with the lower value.

In the next turn, the attacker and defender are switched, and the cards are set and opened in the same way, and damage is dealt until the winner is determined.

Finally, the player with the most life is the winner when all of his or her opponent's life is depleted or when there are no more cards left.
